objective: Consolidate a dashboard widget onto canonical VT-SYNC/analytics-canon evidence without changing metric meaning or persisted widget identity.
why: Demonstrate a complete Crown handoff using current ViewTube dashboard and analytics ownership rules.
nonGoals: Do not create a second analytics cache.
Do not rename public widget IDs.
Do not change OAuth scopes or billing rules.
acceptance: The widget reads the same canonical values and provenance as equivalent tables and Brain evidence.
Loading, empty, blocked, stale and error states remain representable.
Relevant dashboard contract tests and production build pass.
rollback: Revert only the mission-scoped feature branch commit(s); preserve prior dashboard layout schema and canonical data adapters.
